_about: Target languages. Copy this file to %APPDATA%\R1999Translator\engine\languages.json and add or change entries there. Required per entry: name (shown in the menu) and nllb (NLLB-200 code, for example deu_Latn). Optional: join (text placed between translated sentences, default a space, empty for Japanese and Chinese), native_names (transliterate names into the language, default true for non Latin scripts), fonts (font families the UI should prefer for this language, the first one is the default; a language is hidden when the machine has no font that can show it), model_repo (a CTranslate2 NLLB model on Hugging Face to use for this language instead of the default one, downloaded the first time the language is selected).
